subject.title: fix: external plugin tabs fail under gateway auth

question: Should external plugin tabs use this five-minute route-scoped, auth-generation-bound HttpOnly cookie as the permanent gateway-auth handoff?
rationale: Both the cookie design and a host-mediated proxy can solve the user-visible bug, but choosing which bearer boundary OpenClaw will support requires explicit Gateway/auth ownership rather than automated patch judgment.

options.title: Approve bounded cookie handoff
options.body: Accept the current route-scoped and generation-bound design after contributor-provided live browser security proof.

options.title: Require a host proxy
options.body: Reject browser bearer cookies and redesign external tab loading through a host-mediated authenticated proxy.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded cookie handoff
recommendation.body: Accept the current route-scoped and generation-bound design after contributor-provided live browser security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest concrete history signal is the authenticated Control UI bootstrap HTTP boundary that this PR extends.
